findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax introduced into an i18next message bundle
findings.body: The account-ui message bundle uses i18next/react-i18next placeholders elsewhere, such as '{{app}}' and '{{date}}'. The changed 'error-invalid-multivalued-size' message now uses '{0}', '{1}', and '{2,choice,...}', which i18next will not interpolate or evaluate as Java MessageFormat. As a result, the account UI will show the raw pattern or a broken validation message when this error occurs. This key should keep i18next-compatible interpolation/pluralization or the UI localization layer needs explicit support for this format.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax introduced into an i18next message bundle
findings.body: The admin-ui message bundle is used with i18next-style interpolation, and this key previously used '{{0}}', '{{1}}', and '{{2}}'. It was changed to '{0}', '{1}', and '{2,choice,...}', which is Java MessageFormat syntax and is not understood by i18next. The admin UI will therefore not substitute the parameters or pluralize the message correctly. This is a user-visible localization/contract break for the admin UI.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message contains Italian text
findings.body: The 'totpStep1' value in the Lithuanian account messages was changed to 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see the wrong language for the OTP setup instruction. The value should be restored to a proper Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message contains Italian text
findings.body: The 'loginTotpStep1' value in the Lithuanian login messages was changed to 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see the wrong language during OTP setup. The value should be restored to a proper Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Property resource bundles are read without explicit UTF-8 decoding
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() constructs PropertyResourceBundle directly from a FileInputStream. That path uses the legacy Properties InputStream loading behavior, which is not appropriate for the UTF-8 theme message files used by Keycloak (Arabic, Chinese, Cyrillic, etc.). Non-ASCII values can be garbled before HTML verification, leading to incorrect validation results or spurious failures. Use an InputStreamReader with StandardCharsets.UTF_8 when creating the PropertyResourceBundle.

findings.title: Choice expressions are stripped before sanitization, hiding any markup they contain
findings.body: normalizeValue() replaces the entire '{n,choice,...}' expression with '...' for linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit* keys and error-invalid-multivalued-size. Any HTML placed inside the choice alternatives is therefore never passed to the OWASP sanitizer. Since these messages can be rendered in HTML themes or emails, markup can bypass the check by being embedded in a choice expression. The verifier should validate the textual choice alternatives instead of discarding the whole expression.

findings.title: English companion file path is derived with fragile replaceAll regexes
findings.body: The English file path is computed by applying replaceAll('resources-community', 'resources') and replaceAll('_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties', '_en.properties') to the absolute path. This operates on the whole path rather than the file name, so matching substrings outside the message file name can produce a wrong path. It can also fail for locale suffixes not matched by the regex. If the derived path is wrong, verification fails with an inability-to-read-file error. Resolve the English companion from the file name and locale instead of regex-replacing the absolute path.

findings.title: templateHelp normalization removes arbitrary uppercase tags after CLAIM.
findings.body: The normalization for templateHelp removes any uppercase tag following 'CLAIM.' rather than only the intended literal text 'CLAIM.<NAME>'. This hides markup such as 'CLAIM.<B>' or 'CLAIM.<SCRIPT>' from the sanitizer. If this help text is ever rendered as HTML, the verifier could pass unsafe markup. Use an exact quoted replacement for 'CLAIM.<NAME>' or a precise allow-list.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account message uses Traditional Chinese characters
findings.body: The 'totpStep1' value in messages_zh_CN.properties was changed to '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：', which uses Traditional Chinese characters. The zh_CN locale should use Simplified Chinese, for example '在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：'.

findings.title: Danish email HTML still contains a stray 'n' before 'Hvis'
findings.body:
identityProviderLinkBodyHtml was fixed to close the final paragraph, but the text still reads '

nHvis du ikke vil forbinde disse konti...'. The leading 'n' appears to be a typo or leftover and will be shown to users. It should be '

Hvis du ikke vil forbinde disse konti...'.

findings.title: Test resource loading uses URL.getFile() without URL decoding
findings.body: getFile() creates a File from resource.getFile(). URL.getFile() does not decode URL-encoded characters such as '%20', so tests can fail when the repository path contains spaces or other characters that are percent-encoded. Use Paths.get(resource.toURI()).toFile() instead.
